//comment-parallelization: ParallelizeTestCollections=false is also set in the csproj — kept in
both places so a future xunit upgrade that respects the runner json
over the csproj setting doesn't silently re-enable parallel runs.
Several tests mutate process-wide state (env vars, ServiceLocator,
Avalonia Dispatcher); concurrent execution would interfere.
//comment-timeout: Default per-test timeout of 10 minutes. The slowest E2E test
(round-trip a snapshot through a real Backrest daemon + restic +
rclone against a cloud destination) takes 5-8 minutes on the
author's machine. 10 min is generous enough to absorb CI
slowdowns without letting a genuinely hung test pin the whole
suite indefinitely. Individual tests can override with
[Fact(Timeout=...)] if they need a tighter or looser deadline.
